page.overview:
Who is Dende?

In his first appearance, Dende is very similar to Piccolo as a child except for their attire.

During the Great Saiyaman Saga, Dende grows taller with sharper eyes and wears the clothes of a Guardian of Earth, an appearance which he also has in Dragon Ball Online. In the manga, during the events of the Buu Saga, Dende reverts back to his child appearance, which he retains until at least the Galactic Patrol Prisoner Saga. He also keeps his child appearance through the Dragon Ball Super anime.

Dende grows taller again by the time of Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero and the Peaceful World Saga, though still wears clothing similar to those he wore as a child. He also has this look in the anime version of the Buu Saga and retains it for his appearances for Dragon Ball GT.

Dende is a gentle and soft-spoken young Namekian. Like most Namekians, Dende is peaceful by nature and as one of the youngest of his race, Dende was originally introduced as a shy boy, barely talking unless needed. Despite this, Dende was shown to have a strong loyalty to his people, willing to risk himself to do the right thing. Upon meeting Gohan and Krillin, after the two Earthlings saved him, he gradually opened up and grew close to them, so much that he was moved to tears when he had to say goodbye to them and overjoyed upon finally getting to see them. Despite his age, Dende is very mature and knowledgeable for his age. Deemed a prodigy by his people, Dende proved very advanced in the spiritual teachings of the Namekians, enough to be chosen as the next Guardian of Earth.
